subject: OCCURS clause
notes: kb/Work PB80 (2026-08-18) + PB202 (2026-09-22). The DIRECTION LAW is written once, PlaceRenderer.UsesCurrentExtent: GR8a (data-name-1 outside the group) uses the current-count part in BOTH directions (a receiving store touches only it - ReceiveInto); GR8b (inside) uses the current-count part when the group is a SENDING operand and the MAXIMUM length only when it is a RECEIVING operand. Every channel (AsImage, AsBits, AsNat) and every storage shape (record-struct member, Tier-B / BASED class-tier window) asks it. PB202 corrected the ref-mod READ arm, which gated the slice on DependingInside: false and read the MAXIMUM image of a depending-inside group (G(4:) at count 2 gave cdddeee; 8.4.3.3.4 GR5 makes the ref-mod a subset of the group referenced as a sending operand), and its receiving twin: the ref-mod splice BASE is now read in the receiving direction (SpliceBase), so a depending-inside national group keeps positions past the current extent under a maximum-length store. The national ODO extent was also counted in mixed units (byte prefix + carrier element width: 11 positions for 1 + 2 x 3 = 7) - OdoModel.WrapGroup now takes the element stride on the PhysicalWidth byte basis. A BASED ODO record sent its MAXIMUM before PB80; the WORKING-STORAGE twin is the control on every golden row; a REDEFINES-class ODO group cannot be declared (13.18.44 SR forbids redefining a variable-size item), so BASED is the only class-tier shape.
